title: What is Fugu AI? The Truth About the Latest AI Benchmarks
description:
Fugu AI claims to be better than Mythos and top models, but is it really a new LLM? In this video, we look at the Sakana Runner GitHub and discover that Fugu might just be routing requests to GPT, Claude, and Gemini. I'll show you why the benchmarks might be manipulated and what's actually going on under the hood.

Key Topics:
- What is Sakana Runner?
- Fugu AI vs Mythos Preview
- Custom model pools explained
- Why Fugu failed the Fable 5 benchmark
- The truth about open source model weights
